title: Thua
summary: Raleigh names Thua in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). The midwife named with Sephora. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
